title: LADDER: Language-Driven Slice Discovery and Error Rectification in Vision Classifiers.
abstract: Slice discovery refers to identifying systematic biases in the mistakes of pre-trained vision models. Current slice discovery methods in computer vision rely on converting input images into sets of attributes and then testing hypotheses about configurations of these precomputed attributes associated with elevated error patterns.
